PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/1.3/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://example.com/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?point ?id WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone ; rdfs:label "Perimeter_ZN_2" .
  ?point brick:hasSubComponent ?zone .
  ?point a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?id .
}

rows.sort()

print(day)
